name: b6-safety-invariant
title: Safety invariant: the document changes only through /accept

git.commit_note: branch main has no commits yet; numbers come from the uncommitted working tree

environment.docker_desktop_note: Docker Desktop on Windows: containers run in the WSL2 VM; Redis/Postgres/Qdrant and sandboxes cross the Windows<->VM boundary

conditions.editors: 2 y-protocols clients (node 1, node 2) typing 1 char / 60 ms at the end of their own line; no deletions
conditions.observer: y-protocols client on node 1 decoding every received update
conditions.foreign_update: structs from a client other than editors A/B, or any deletion
conditions.sandbox: real hardened Docker sandbox via worker (WORKER_CONCURRENCY=4)
test_overrides: a fresh test user per 40 trials (AI_DAILY_LIMIT_PER_USER default 50 untouched)

protocol: single run of all trials (correctness check, not a timing benchmark); scenario sequence seeded

extra.note: samples_ms = POST /ai/fix wall time per trial
